name: LinkNodes
description: Read-only Chainlink developer toolkit. Public /v1 API for Data Feeds, CCIP lanes, operators, 24/7 streams, and a cached Chainlink for Agents catalog. No API keys. No write operations.

skills.name: Data Feed lookup
skills.description: Resolve a Chainlink Data Feed by chain slug and feed slug, including live latestRoundData.

skills.name: Cross-chain feed compare
skills.description: Query the same feed on every chain it is deployed on and return the spread in bps.

skills.name: CCIP registry and lane lookup
skills.description: Router addresses, chain selectors, and per-lane support from Chainlink's CCIP directory.

skills.name: 24/7 streams list
skills.description: List-only catalog of Chainlink 24/7 Data Streams. No live report prices.

skills.name: Node operators
skills.description: Curated directory of well-known Chainlink node operators.

skills.name: Chainlink for Agents catalog
skills.description: Cached public catalog from agents.chain.link, including published per-workflow USDC prices when the gateway exposes them without payment.
